build_feature_encoder: build a FeatureEncoder to encode 2D feature maps with a configurable convolution and downscale factor
create_embedding_module: create an Embedding module that one-hot encodes pixel values and applies a strided convolution
build_camera_encoder: build a CameraEncoder that averages pools the camera observation and projects it through a linear layer
create_downscale_module: create a Downscale component that applies layer norm, relu, and strided convolution to reduce spatial resolution
build_resnet_visual: build a Resnet module with configurable residual blocks for processing 2D visual feature maps
